# orly

> A Claude Code plugin that keeps an evidence-backed picture of a codebase against its
> requirements: requirement → source locations → evidence → satisfied | violated | unknown.
> `orly eval` evaluates every requirement now (checks in code, file questions to the System One
> judge jev in one request, results reused while inputs are unchanged). A Stop hook runs the
> same evaluation and refuses to end a turn while a requirement is violated.

- [README](README.md): what it does, install, usage.
- [Writing requirements](docs/specs.txt): the spec tree, headers, the four rules, evaluation and reuse.
- `bin/orly.ts`: `orly eval | judge | specs | hook`. `src/`: `turn.ts` (the bounded turn),
  `specs.ts` (requirements), `evaluate.ts` (the one evaluation mechanism), `gate.ts` (the Stop hook).
